about_the_game:
Synopsis

Leona the gunslinger is, for various reasons, living life as a desperado.

One day, she meets Lurie, a sketchy demi-human, who convinces her to join the combat tournament at the Colosseum.

Apparently, if she escapes elimination and wins the tournament, she can be pardoned from all her charges.

However, if she loses, she'll not only be publicly violated by the winner, but she'll also become their property... their slave.

Will Leona conquer this arena and emerge as the champion, or will she live the rest of her life as a humiliated slave?

Gameplay

- Perform various jobs to enhance your abilities and earn money.

- Take a break once in a while to restore heatlh and remove negative status effects.

- Spend money on gear, items and specialized training.

- Watch out for sexual harassment at work!

Combat

- Fight enemies in 1v1 deathmatches.

- Prepare your deck before battle, and select the best moves to counter your enemy.

- Each skill has a fixed cost and will not activate if Leona's stats are insufficient.

- Accurately predicting the opponent's next move depends on Leona's ability to read ahead.

- Quick move selection and successive turns without taking damage will increase Leona's excitement gauge. A high excitement level triggers her Trigger-Happy mode, which increases attack power.

Leona the Silver-Tongued

Leona is a talkative gal so she will need to use her cunning and honeyed words to haggle and negotiate.

While this sometimes puts her at an advantage, there will also be times where she'll have to agree to naughtier requests.

These requests may endanger your chastity or those of other characters.

Defeat Mode

Losing in the Colosseum doesn't mean Game Over.

...Leona just has to continue living life as a slave.

Day after day of humiliation will slowly chip at Leona's psyche. The game is only over when Leona completely breaks and submits.

Each chapter leads to a different defeat story and outfit. Watch the tough Leona submit to all sorts of depravity in Live2D animation!

Features

- 33 H-CGs (including Live2D scenes)

- Seven portrait poses x Seven different outfits

- Special outfits for each defeat situation

- Naughty situations include: Workplace sexual harassment, prostitution, H-events in town, public r*pe and reverse public r*pe after battles, freeuse & group violation as a slave, and also a sprinkling of lovey-dovey sex.

- Continue playing the game even after defeat! Game progression will stop, but the sex never ends!

- Clear the game to experience the New Game + features!

- This game depicts physical violence but does not feature any major injuries that would lead to death. (no torn limbs etc.)

- Every female character has their own H-scene

*All content within the game is uncensored.*
